notes.title: Update 0.34 is live! Arcade mode is here!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Version 0.34 is already on Steam and it includes the following major updates:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30034093/880a002f8fbc6fc2a21ba301396debcbfcd65d94.png

Arcade mode
Arcade mode (sandbox) is now available! New Arcade Mode will allow you to fight waves of enemies in randomly generated Space Rifts. 
It’s just the first version and we will develop in future releases.
Have fun!

Game Settings screen 
To support arcade mode, we have implemented Game Settings screen:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30034093/875c9f25dd09158da1e012c8f32925394fc8d3ab.png

Balancing
Normal, Hard, Veteran & Ace difficulty levels are rebalanced to be easier.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Development status update 17-FEB-2018
notes.notes:
Hello!

Our regular update on status and plans of the game development.

ALREADY RELEASED
Let's start with what has already been implemented:

    Balance. Balancing of the game was significantly reworked, improved and released on 22-JAN-2018. See  Update 0.33.00.00 announcement for more details.
    Gamepad support. Gamepad support including full ship control and object interaction has been implemented. To interact with the main menu and in-game menu you need to use a mouse. See Update 0.33.01.02 announcement for more details.
    A number of improvements and fixes. We hear you! And we do our best to make Origin Space better. Update 0.33.05.02 brings a number of improvements and fixes based on your feedback. and 

DEVELOPMENT PLANS
Our reviewed and updated development priorities are as follows:

Sandbox mode
A sandbox mode will allow players to travel around the game world without bounds of the campaign story. We expect to release this feature about March 12, 2018.

Online cooperative mode
We plan to release a version with online cooperative mode support in early April 2018.

Engineer player class & Crafting
Among the priorities of future development we see the following: 

    To add one more player class Engineer.
    To implement crafting of items.

notes.title: Development status update 02-FEB-2018
notes.notes:
Hello!

Upcoming release status as on 02-FEB-2018:

Gamepad support
Gamepad support in accordance with Steam Partial Controller Support is at the final stage of development and testing. 

It will include full ship control and object interaction. Some interface interactions (like store, inventory, etc.) will still require using of mouse. 

We expect to release the update on February 06, 2018.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Development status update 26-JAN-2018
notes.notes:
Hello!

Our regular update on status and plans of the game development.

Released: Balance improvement
Balancing of the game was significantly reworked, improved and released on 22-JAN-2018. See  Update 0.33.00.00 announce for more details.
It was just fist iteration of balance improvement. Based on players' feedback we plan to continue work on developing the balance of the game.

Upcoming release: Gamepad support
Gamepad support in accordance with Steam Partial Controller Support scheduled to release on  02-FEB-2018. It will include full ship control and object interaction, but interface interactions (like store, inventory, etc.) will still require using of mouse. 

Based on your feedback and wishes, we have reviewed and updated our development priorities in the following way.

Sandbox mode
A sandbox mode will allow players to travel around the game world without bounds of the campaign story. We expect to release a sandbox mode in the first half of March 2018.

Online cooperative mode
We plan to release a version with online cooperative mode support in early April 2018.

Engineer player class & Crafting
One more player class Engineer will be added. Crafting of items will be implemented.

notes.title: New: Update 0.33.00.00 is on Steam
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30034093/0e12e6f408cf7b7d74fdf350ff370dd9216288aa.jpg

Hello!

Update 0.33.00.00 has been released and available on Store now. The update includes the following:

Balancing
As we promised earlier based on your feedback, we have significantly reworked and improved balancing of the game. In comparison with versions before this update, you should expect the following changes in your experience:

    Levels from 1 to 10 (approximately) - minor changes from previous version
    Levels from 11 to 35 (approximately) - difficulty will gradually increase as the level increases 
    Levels over 35 - significant increase of difficulty 

Note! For existing characters it may be a good idea to upgrade items (e.g. by visiting the store) to make sure you are prepared for battles in conditions of reworked balance.

Certainly it is just fist iteration of balance improvement. Based on your feedback we plan to continue work on developing the balance of the game and release more updates.

Other
Some minor fixes.

notes.title: Update 0.32.06.01
notes.notes:
Hello,

Update 0.32.06.01 is available now and it includes:

    Added option to enable absolute ship controls (UP always UP relative to screen when enabled), by default it is disabled (controls are relative to the ship forward vector, as was before this patch). You can find this checkbox in Game tab of Options screen.
    Added settings to Display Enemy Hitpoint Bars (enabled by default) which enables enemy hp bars on screen. 
    Several minor fixes.

notes.title: Development status update 10-JAN-2018
notes.notes:
Hello!

As we promised, we are going regularly update about the status and plans of the game development.
Based on your feedback and wishes, we have identified the following development priorities.

Balance improvement
This task has the highest priority. We plan to complete this work and release an update with a significantly improved balance by January 19, 2018.

Gamepad support
We are planning to implement gamepad support in accordance with Steam Partial Controller Support by the end of January 2018. It will include full ship control and object interaction, but interface interactions (like store, inventory, etc.) will still require using of mouse. 

Sandbox mode
A sandbox mode will allow players to travel around the game world without bounds of the campaign story.

Engineer player class
One more player class – Engineer –  will be added. 

Online cooperative mode & Crafting
Online cooperative mode & Crafting of items will be implemented.

notes.title: Update 0.32.04.01
notes.notes:
Update 0.32.01.02 includes:

•	Changing localization in-game now switches comics localization correctly
•	Various Russian localization fixes
•	Friendly NPC now look friendlier (green HP bars)
•	AI ships now better manage their ship abilities when they cannot be used (AI will less often stand doing nothing)
•	Increased enemy HP and damage on difficulties above normal
